alerts.text: What changed since the 20:45 report: the agent now treats R12 trades as changeable until Tuesday's first tip-off, so this report plans R12 again from your pre-R12 squad. Your four trades are almost the best plan. The one suggested change is to undo Brizuela → Herrera and make Davidovac → Procida. No new injury or coach news since this afternoon (checked eurohoops, sportando, Real Madrid and Milan news).
Fix the app lineup whatever you do: Herrera is still your 6th man. Use 3-1-1: Robinson, Nunn, Feliz / Vezenkov (C) / Diarra, with Malcolm as 6th man.

Undo check: the site still shows pre-R11 prices, and the app's are about 0.1–0.4 higher. After undoing Brizuela → Herrera, check that Procida fits in the bank you see. If it doesn't, keep your trades (Variation B): the difference is under 1 point of chance.
Only Real Madrid play on Wednesday (at Beşiktaş). Every other R12 game is Tuesday, so Feliz (and Procida in A) are your only late options for the armband or a swap.

R13 plan (4 new trades after Wednesday's games): Nunn → Payne, coach Masiulis (ZAL) → Albert (VBC), Feliz → Loyd, and Joksimović → Tyson Ward (Davidovac → Ward if you keep Variation B). It'll be redone after R12.
No bookmaker key. Zalgiris–Bayern: the site's 81% (+11) matches Zalgiris' five-game win streak and Bayern's 3-8 record, so Masiulis (ZAL) stays the coach pick.

rumours.text: Milan are signing center Ze'Rik Onyema from Scafati (buy-out). The announcement is expected early next week. Booker is out about 3 months (right rectus femoris tendon rupture).
rumours.impact: Diop keeps the big-man minutes in R12 (vs Zvezda) and probably R13. Onyema threatens his role from about R14, so Diop is a sell in the unlimited window.

rumours.text: Milutinov fractured the tip of his right index finger and misses Aris (Sunday) and Maccabi (Tuesday), with a return expected around 24 Nov. Montero is out long-term, and Dorsey isn't expected back for these games.
rumours.impact: Good for Vezenkov's minutes and touches at Maccabi, and helps Fall and Jones. It's also a reason Tyson Ward has a bigger role on Thursday vs Madrid.

rumours.text: Bruno Fernando is out 3–4 weeks with a calf injury (team doctor, after an MRI), expected back around 10 Dec. Papagiannis is back to cover.
rumours.impact: Malcolm and the guards (Payne, Loyd) get more usage. Efes are thinner in R12 at Dubai but heavy favourites at home to ASVEL in R13.

rumours.text: Nunn missed the 8 Nov league game at AEK because he travelled to Qatar for a passport (naturalisation). He's back for the EuroLeague.
rumours.impact: It doesn't affect R12, but it explains his missing domestic minutes. PAN may manage him on the R12–R13 back-to-back (at Virtus, then at Zalgiris).

rumours.text: Fenerbahçe's R17–R18 home games against Hapoel and Maccabi move to Munich.

review: Scorecard: no finished round to grade yet (R12 starts Tuesday). R11 (unofficial, our count) came to about 168: Vezenkov (C) 57, Faye 21, Feliz 19, and coach Penarroya (PAR) +20, while Madar 11, Joksimović 2 and Davidovac 8 held it back. Calls: selling Madar was right (broken nose), and Masiulis (ZAL) still looks the best R12 coach. Owned miss: the 20:45 report treated your R12 trades as final and jumped to R13, but they can still be changed until Tuesday's tip-off. This run re-checks them, and they hold up except one bench trade. Research: 12 searches, 2 pages read, 2 players unverified (Diop's and Marinković's domestic games). This re-run builds on 27 searches and 5 pages from the earlier runs today.
window_plan: I'd make rebuild 1 with one change. Sell Nunn, Herrera, Davidovac, Joksimović and Diarra; buy Payne, Frisch, Procida, Valančiūnas and Llull, with coach Martinez (RMB). Valančiūnas is the clear upgrade at center, and Procida and Frisch are minutes-backed cheap enablers. I'd check Llull against Madrid's guard returns (Campazzo, Maledon) before the window, and keep Diop only until Onyema is registered. The R13 trades above already move Nunn → Payne, so the window needs fewer moves. Prices will shift after R12–R13, so I'll redo this on 21 Nov.
